_doc: Machine-readable product-studio org (S0.1, SP-20260530-001). domains -> director -> leads -> specialists; β referee, α orchestrator; cross-domain gauntlets. `routing` maps each S0.2 artifact `contract.owner_domain` to the org domain + owning role. Enforced by /scan:domain-routing (validates against schemas/contracts/*.schema.json). v0.1 REVISABLE. This is the MAP, not the agents — agents for the NEW roles are built in Wave 2 (artifact-before-agent iron rule); `agent` = existing subagent_type, or null = pending.

referee.scope: Cross-domain conflict, risk, final ship gate. Enters intra-domain ONLY for ship-gate or cross-domain conflicts — NOT every intra-domain disagreement (not an intra-domain appeal court). β EVT-org-gpt-rereview-beta-001.

leads.owns: requirement authoring (build_spec/PRD via /sprint:design, verified by req-reviewer); per-product backlog ranking + within-sprint sequencing
product-driven QA; QA/fix-priority under product-priority-over-severity; directs the QA failure-mode scanner
leads.note: Renamed from Director of QA; reports to Director of Product Mgmt. Keep the director-of-qa dispatch alias until all refs migrate.

leads.owns: deep audience layer + audience-mining pipeline; audience_dossier
Agora/E5 voice; owns the 'Chief' coherence review

engineering.note: +Foundation/Integration builder roles only if the pilot shows shared-file pain (S1.3 Gamma integration phase owns shared files first).

design-quality.note: The named design authority across app-design (Product) and web-design (Marketing) — a gauntlet, not a person. A component library alone is not an owner.

claims_boundary.note: Marketing owns the market promise; Product owns the product-verifiable claim; they must not blur. Security/compliance review stays independent of Product/Marketing pressure (its own gauntlet lane). Rooted as the shared `claims-boundary` base principle.

routing._doc: Each S0.2 artifact `contract.owner_domain` -> the org domain + owning role. /scan:domain-routing asserts every owner_domain present in schemas/contracts/ has an entry here, and every entry's domain is defined above (or 'cross-domain').

enforcer_emitted.note: decision_record — emitted by any domain's enforcer in oneshot, no human present
